package soak

// PLANT: exactly ONE goroutine of a new kind that never exits, started on the
// 500th request only (warm-up is ~65 requests, so the baseline is already taken). The goroutine total grows by 1, inside oracle (b)'s
// tolerance (+3), so this is what oracle (c) exists for.
// Expected: oracle (b) goroutines PASS, oracle (c) new-stack FAIL naming plantOneGoroutineLeak.

import (
	"net/http"
	"sync/atomic"
)

func init() {
	handlerWrappers = append(handlerWrappers, func(next http.Handler, _ *soakEnv) http.Handler {
		block := make(chan struct{})
		plantCleanups = append(plantCleanups, func() { close(block) })
		var n atomic.Int64
		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			if n.Add(1) == 500 {
				go plantOneGoroutineLeak(block)
			}
			next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
		})
	})
}

func plantOneGoroutineLeak(block chan struct{}) { <-block }
